drhp.business: KRM Ayurveda operates an integrated Ayurvedic healthcare platform combining hospitals, day-care clinics, telemedicine and Ayurvedic medicines within a patient-centric ecosystem. It manufactures Ayurvedic formulations addressing kidney and liver health, digestive care, skin wellness and stress/lifestyle management, alongside delivering clinical healthcare services such as Panchkarma therapies and disease-management programs.

drhp.expansion: The Company operates 16 hospital/day-care locations across Karnataka, Bihar, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Delhi, plus a manufacturing factory at Kundli, Haryana and its registered office in Delhi. During FY 2025-26 the Company's foray into hospitals complemented its existing business, and management states it will continue to focus on strengthening the infrastructure, healthcare team, operational processes and service capabilities of the facility. Going forward, capital allocation priorities include healthcare infrastructure and capacity expansion.
